tool_action.private_thought: Built 2/2/2 for $300, cash $60. Even-build legal. p1 on Connecticut rolls before me and hits VA/States/StC on 4/3/1 (6/36) for $180/$150/$150 — that either drops them to ~$7 or forces a house sale, and blocks their $150 red build. If they miss (30/36) they can add one red house; a $250–$300 hit is survivable by selling pink houses, not fatal. BW $1700 and PP $1100 are fatal either way (max liquidation ~$730). Do not unmortgage TN (orange block vs p4) or Penn RR. Do not sell TN to p4. Keep GOOJF and stay in jail if sent. Next goal: 3-house pinks ($450–$500) to crack p4's light blues; only 2 houses left in bank after this.
